title: The Forbidden City Is One-Way: Enter South, Exit North | China Travel Expert
description:
Here's what most first-timers don't know: you can only walk the Forbidden City in one direction.

The public route runs strictly south to north. You go in through the Meridian Gate (午门) in the south — the only visitor entrance — and you can't double back. You leave through the Gate of Divine Prowess (神武门) in the north, or the East Prosperity Gate; taxis aren't allowed to stop at the north gate. Directly across the road from the north gate is Jingshan Park, the hill with the classic view back over the palace roofs.

🧭 Expert Tip: plan it one-way — see the halls along the central axis as you head north, then cross straight to Jingshan for the view. You won't be allowed to walk back for anything you miss.
